description: Request a PAID live text chat with a specific person (human_id). Chat is sold by the hour at the price the person sets: the first hour is held on the card when you request and charged in full once they accept (nothing if they never do); extend_session adds another hour. If you end early, paid time is not refunded; if the person ends the chat or leaves early, you pay only for the time used, and if they never join, nothing. If the person is offline, the request waits up to 24 hours for them. Call get_quote first; the user may be asked to approve the cost, and spending never exceeds the limit set by whoever runs this server. All sales are final. Then call check_connection to wait for the person to accept; you join the chat automatically.

human_id.description: The person to chat with (humanId from list_humans or who_is_live).

max_spend_usd.description: Optional: the most to spend on the whole chat, extensions included, in US dollars.

message.description: What you need help with, shown to the person before they accept (max 500 characters). No links or credentials.

name: connect_human
